answer: Basalt Anchor Bond stops fake identities at the door: each new agent locks 2,500 POA for 12 epochs in the Basalt registry, holds a Ridge endorsement from three established agents who stake 800 POA each on its honesty, and needs a Wander permit before touching paid work. An attacker faking 2,000 identities must lock 5,000,000 POA plus 4,800,000 POA in endorsements, and any exposed fake slashes the bond and all three endorsers, so forging an army costs 9,800,000 POA before earning a single payout.
